title: Atypical multi-axis combination (non-stereotypical)
description: Deliberately atypical combination: high endothelial + metabolic stress with only moderate inflammation and delayed structural injury — outside single-disease stereotypes but still within plausible host-response space.

realism_evidence.proxy_notes: Individual axes are literature-supported host responses; the *combination and timing* are the atypical element under test.

model_derived_components: low cell-death relative to functional impairment
interaction_hypotheses: High vascular + metabolic axes can drive substantial contractile loss without proportional acute cell death
scenario_assumptions.notes: Atypical but not fully held-out; used to test abnormality recognition beyond ordinary disease labels.
